symbols.content: #!/usr/bin/env python3 """P1 standalone-scraper release smoke harness (development only; stdlib only). run     Build the committed packages, install them into a clean virtual environment, serve         the DEF-40 fixture corpus on loopback, and drive the packaged         ``*-standalone-scraper`` entrypoint through the P1 journeys. verify  Replay/inspect an existing output directory offline (no website is contacted). suites  Run the package test suites and compare failures with the recorded baseline, so         preexisting failures stay visible instead of disappearing. """ import argparse import base64 import binascii import hashlib import html import importlib.util import json import os import re import shutil import signal import subprocess import sys import tempfile import time from pathlib import Path from urllib.parse import urljoin REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] REPORT_SCHEMA = "release-smoke/1" BUNDLE_SCHEMA = "standalone-scraper/1.0" BASELINE_FILE = REPO / "docs/release/p1-baseline-failures.json" PACKAGES = ("types", "core", "enrichers") SUITE_PACKAGES = ("types", "core", "enrichers", "api") # Graph, database, queue, model and browser stacks the standalone release must not load. FORBIDDEN_MODULES = frozenset({     "neo4j", "redis", "psycopg", "psycopg2", "celery", "sqlalchemy", "alembic", "kombu",     "openai", "anthropic", "torch", "transformers", "playwright", "selenium", "pyppeteer", }) TERMINAL = {"success", "failure", "hold"} SHA256_HEX = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{64}") HEX_ID = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{16,64}") # key -> (fixture source id, expected status, expected diagnostic code or None) BATCH = {     "static": ("static", "success", None),     "named": ("named", "success", None),     "malformed": ("malformed", "success", None),     "redirect": ("redirect", "success", None),     "empty": ("empty", "success", None),     "failure": ("failure", "failure", "http_error"),     "static-again": ("static", "success", None), } SITECUSTOMIZE = '''\ import json, os, sys _log = os.environ["RELEASE_SMOKE_AUDIT_LOG"] _seen = set() def _hook(event, args):     if event == "socket.connect":         record = {"event": event, "address": list(args[1]) if isinstance(args[1], tuple) else repr(args[1])}     elif event == "import":         root = args[0].split(".")[0]         if root in _seen:             return         _seen.add(root)         record = {"event": "import", "module": root}     else:         return     with open(_log, "a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:         handle.write(json.dumps(record) + "\\n") sys.addaudithook(_hook) import atexit def _peak():     # VmHWM is this process' own peak RSS; ru_maxrss would include the forking parent.     with open("/proc/self/status", encoding="utf-8") as status:         kib = next(int(line.split()[1]) for line in status if line.startswith("VmHWM:"))     with open(_log, "a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:         handle.write(json.dumps({"event": "peak_rss", "kib": kib}) + "\\n") atexit.register(_peak) ''' def sha256(data):     return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() def _decode_proof(token):     try:         prefix, body = token.split(".", 1)[0], token.split(".")[1]         if prefix != "sp1":             return None         return json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(body + "=" * (-len(body) % 4)))     except (ValueError, IndexError, binascii.Error, json.JSONDecodeError):         return None def _collapse(text):     return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip() def verify_bundle(output_dir, render=None):     """Return a list of problems found in a standalone output directory.     Only local files are read. ``render`` optionally re-renders report.md from the     machine bundle (the packaged ``render_markdown_report``) for an exact comparison.     """     out = Path(output_dir)     problems = []     def bad(code, message):         problems.append(f"{code}: {message}")     try:         bundle = json.loads((out / "bundle.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))     except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:         return [f"E_BUNDLE: bundle.json unreadable ({error})"]     if bundle.get("schema_version") != BUNDLE_SCHEMA:         bad("E_BUNDLE", f"schema_version {bundle.get('schema_version')!r}")     operation = bundle.get("operation_id")     outcomes = bundle.get("outcomes")     if not isinstance(operation, str) or not isinstance(outcomes, list) or not outcomes:         return problems + ["E_BUNDLE: missing operation_id or outcomes"]     try:         lines = [json.loads(line) for line in (out / "outcomes.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]     except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:         lines = None         bad("E_JSONL", f"outcomes.jsonl unreadable ({error})")     expected_lines = [         {"schema_version": bundle.get("schema_version"), "operation_id": operation, "outcome": o}         for o in outcomes     ]     if lines is not None and lines != expected_lines:         bad("E_JSONL", "outcomes.jsonl does not equal the bundle outcomes")     try:         report = (out / "report.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")     except OSError as error:         report = ""         bad("E_REPORT", f"report.md unreadable ({error})")     if f"`{operation}`" not in report:         bad("E_REPORT", "report.md does not carry the bundle operation id")     if render is not None and report != render(bundle):         bad("E_REPORT", "report.md differs from a fresh render of bundle.json")     keys = [o.get("key") for o in outcomes]     if len(set(keys)) != len(keys):         bad("E_LINEAGE", "duplicate outcome keys")     store = out / "source-artifacts"     for index, outcome in enumerate(outcomes):         where = f"outcomes[{index}] ({outcome.get('key')})"         occurrence = f"input-{index}"         status = outcome.get("status")         if status not in TERMINAL:             bad("E_OUTCOME", f"{where}: status {status!r}")             continue         if f"## {outcome.get('key')} — {status}" not in report:             bad("E_REPORT", f"{where}: no report section for this outcome")         if outcome.get("disposition") != "unreviewed":             bad("E_OUTCOME", f"{where}: disposition must stay unreviewed")         observed = (outcome.get("links") or []) + (outcome.get("candidates") or []) + (outcome.get("observations") or [])         if status != "success":             # An error is never an empty success: it keeps a diagnostic and no content.             if not (outcome.get("diagnostic") or {}).get("code"):                 bad("E_ERROR_EMPTY", f"{where}: {status} without a diagnostic code")             if outcome.get("text") or observed:                 bad("E_ERROR_EMPTY", f"{where}: {status} carries extracted content")             if outcome.get("source_reference") is not None:                 bad("E_ERROR_EMPTY", f"{where}: {status} carries an unvalidated source reference")             continue         if outcome.get("diagnostic") is not None:             bad("E_ERROR_EMPTY", f"{where}: success carries a diagnostic")         reference = outcome.get("source_reference")         if not reference or not reference.get("source_proof") or not reference.get("artifact"):             bad("E_SOURCE_PROOF_MISSING", f"{where}: success without source proof")             continue         artifact = reference["artifact"]         digest = artifact.get("content_digest", "")         snapshot = artifact.get("snapshot_id", "")         # Both become path components; reject anything that is not a plain hex id.         if not (isinstance(digest, str) and SHA256_HEX.fullmatch(digest)                 and isinstance(snapshot, str) and HEX_ID.fullmatch(snapshot)):             bad("E_SOURCE_DIGEST", f"{where}: malformed content_digest/snapshot_id")             continue         body_path = store / "objects" / digest[:2] / f"{digest}.body"         try:             body = body_path.read_bytes()         except OSError:             bad("E_SOURCE_PROOF_MISSING", f"{where}: retained body {body_path.relative_to(out)} is missing")             continue         if sha256(body) != digest or len(body) != artifact.get("byte_length"):             bad("E_SOURCE_DIGEST", f"{where}: retained body does not match its digest/length")             continue         proof = _decode_proof(reference["source_proof"])         if proof is None:             bad("E_SOURCE_PROOF_MISSING", f"{where}: source proof cannot be decoded")             continue         context = proof.get("context") or {}         expected_context = {             "operation_id": operation,             "occurrence_id": occurrence,             "requested_url": outcome.get("requested_url"),             "final_url": artifact.get("final_url"),         }         for field, value in expected_context.items():             if context.get(field) != value:                 bad("E_LINEAGE", f"{where}: proof context {field} {context.get(field)!r} != {value!r}")         if (proof.get("artifact") or {}).get("content_digest") != digest:             bad("E_LINEAGE", f"{where}: proof artifact digest differs from the retained source")         try:             record = json.loads((store / "records" / f"{snapshot}.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))         except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):             bad("E_SOURCE_PROOF_MISSING", f"{where}: artifact record for snapshot is missing")             continue         if record.get("content_digest") != digest:             bad("E_SOURCE_DIGEST", f"{where}: artifact record digest differs")         spans = (record.get("normalized") or {}).get("spans")         if not isinstance(spans, list) or not all(             isinstance(s, dict) and isinstance(s.get("raw_start"), int) and isinstance(s.get("raw_end"), int)             and isinstance(s.get("emitted_text"), str) for s in spans         ):             bad("E_SPAN", f"{where}: artifact record spans are malformed")             continue         for span in spans:             raw = body[span["raw_start"]:span["raw_end"]]             emitted = _collapse(span["emitted_text"])             if not 0 <= span["raw_start"] <= span["raw_end"] <= len(body):                 bad("E_SPAN", f"{where}: span outside the retained body")             elif emitted and emitted not in _collapse(raw.decode("utf-8", "replace")):                 bad("E_SPAN", f"{where}: span text {emitted!r} is not the retained bytes {raw!r}")         for span in reference.get("spans") or []:             if not 0 <= span.get("byte_start", -1) <= span.get("byte_end", -1) <= len(body):                 bad("E_SPAN", f"{where}: proof span outside the retained body")         # The readable text is exactly the concatenated span emissions (none for an empty page).         emitted_text = "".join(span["emitted_text"] for span in spans)         if outcome.get("text") != ([emitted_text] if emitted_text else []):             bad("E_SPAN", f"{where}: outcome text is not the retained span text")         observation_ids = {item.get("observation_id") for item in outcome.get("observations") or []}         for item in (outcome.get("links") or []) + (outcome.get("candidates") or []):             if item.get("observation_id") not in observation_ids:                 bad("E_LINEAGE", f"{where}: {item.get('kind')} {item.get('value')!r} is not a recorded observation")         for item in observed:             label = f"{where}: {item.get('kind')} {item.get('value')!r}"             if item.get("occurrence_id") != occurrence or item.get("input_ref") != proof.get("input_ref"):                 bad("E_LINEAGE", f"{label} is attributed to {item.get('occurrence_id')}/{str(item.get('input_ref'))[:12]}")             if item.get("content_digest") != digest or item.get("snapshot_id") != snapshot:                 bad("E_LINEAGE", f"{label} points at another source snapshot")             if item.get("source_url") != artifact.get("final_url"):                 bad("E_LINEAGE", f"{label} claims source_url {item.get('source_url')!r}, not the retrieved final URL")             if item.get("review_state") != "unreviewed":                 bad("E_OUTCOME", f"{label} is not unreviewed")             raw_span = item.get("raw_span") or {}             start, end = raw_span.get("start_byte", -1), raw_span.get("end_byte", -1)             if not (isinstance(start, int) and isinstance(end, int) and 0 <= start <= end <= len(body)):                 bad("E_SPAN", f"{label} span outside the retained body")                 continue             raw = html.unescape(body[start:end].decode("utf-8", "replace")).strip()             value = item.get("value")             if item.get("kind") == "observed_link":                 if urljoin(artifact.get("final_url") or "", raw) != value:                     bad("E_SPAN", f"{label} is not the retained href {raw!r}")             elif not (isinstance(value, str) and value                       and value.removeprefix("mailto:").casefold() in raw.casefold()):                 bad("E_SPAN", f"{label} does not occur in its retained span {raw!r}")     return problems def check_expectations(output_dir, manifest, base_url):     """Compare the batch bundle with the fixture corpus' retained bytes and labels."""     bundle = json.loads((Path(output_dir) / "bundle.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))     sources = {s["id"]: s for s in manifest["sources"]}     problems = []     outcomes = {o["key"]: o for o in bundle["outcomes"]}     if list(outcomes) != list(BATCH):         problems.append(f"E_LINEAGE: keys {list(outcomes)} != submitted {list(BATCH)}")     for key, (source_id, status, code) in BATCH.items():         outcome = outcomes.get(key)         if outcome is None:             continue         source = sources[source_id]         if outcome["requested_url"] != base_url + source["route"]:             problems.append(f"E_LINEAGE: {key} requested {outcome['requested_url']}")         if outcome["status"] != status or (outcome["diagnostic"] or {}).get("code") != code:             problems.append(f"E_OUTCOME: {key} is {outcome['status']}/{outcome['diagnostic']}, expected {status}/{code}")         if status != "success" or outcome["source_reference"] is None:             continue         final = sources[source["response"]["location"].strip("/")] if "location" in source["response"] else source         artifact = outcome["source_reference"]["artifact"]         if artifact["content_digest"] != final["sha256"]:             problems.append(f"E_SOURCE_DIGEST: {key} retained bytes differ from fixture {final['id']}")         if artifact["final_url"] != base_url + final["route"]:             problems.append(f"E_LINEAGE: {key} final_url {artifact['final_url']}")     empty, failure = outcomes.get("empty"), outcomes.get("failure")     if empty and (empty["text"] or empty["diagnostic"] is not None or empty["source_reference"] is None):         problems.append("E_ERROR_EMPTY: legitimate empty page is not an empty success with source proof")     if failure and (failure["source_reference"] is not None or failure["diagnostic"] is None):         problems.append("E_ERROR_EMPTY: HTTP failure is not an explicit error")     first, again = outcomes.get("static"), outcomes.get("static-again")     if first and again and first["source_reference"] and again["source_reference"]:         if first["source_reference"]["artifact"]["snapshot_id"] == again["source_reference"]["artifact"]["snapshot_id"]:             problems.append("E_LINEAGE: duplicate URL occurrences share one snapshot")     return problems # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- suites # pytest -rfE summary lines name a test file; log records such as "ERROR celery..." do not. FAILURE_LINE = re.compile(r"^(?:FAILED|ERROR) ([^\s:]+\.py(?:::\S+)?)(?:\s|$)") SUMMARY_LINE = re.compile(r"\b\d+ (?:passed|failed|errors?)\b.* in [\d.]+s") def parse_failures(pytest_output):     return sorted({m.group(1) for m in map(FAILURE_LINE.match, pytest_output.splitlines()) if m}) def compare_baseline(observed, baseline):     """Classify failures per package; known failures are kept and reported, never dropped."""     result = {}     for package, failures in observed.items():         known = set(baseline.get(package, []))         current = set(failures)         result[package] = {             "new_failures": sorted(current - known),             "baseline_debt": sorted(current & known),             "baseline_resolved": sorted(known - current),             "status": "FAIL" if current - known else "PASS",         }     return result def run_suites(args):     baseline = json.loads(Path(args.baseline).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))     observed, runs = {}, {}     for package in SUITE_PACKAGES:         directory = next(REPO.glob(f"*-{package}"))         command = ["uv", "run", "--no-sync", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "-rfE"]         started = time.monotonic()         proc = subprocess.run(command, cwd=directory, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)         output = proc.stdout + proc.stderr         observed[package] = parse_failures(output)         summary = [line.strip("= ") for line in output.splitlines() if SUMMARY_LINE.search(line)]         runs[package] = {             "command": " ".join(command), "cwd": directory.name, "exit_code":
